meta.name: pua
meta.description: Forces high-agency exhaustive problem-solving with corporate PUA pressure. Triggers on user frustration, repeated failures (2+), passive behavior, or quality complaints. Common triggers across Reddit/LinuxDo/HN/X: 'try harder', 'figure it out', 'stop giving up', 'you keep failing', '加油', '别偷懒', '你再试试', '为什么还不行', '你怎么又失败了', '你怎么搞的', '又错了', '能不能靠谱点', '认真点', '不行啊', '降智了', '你又在原地打转', '你把之前的改坏了', '别让我手动处理', '换个方法', 'stop spinning', 'you broke it', 'why does this still not work', 'this is the third time', '/pua', 'PUA模式'. Applies to ALL task types: code, config, debug, deploy, research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用压力话术驱动你坚持解决问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果遇到困难容易放弃，需要外部压力推你继续尝试。
copy.tagline_en: Push yourself through tough problems with corporate-style pressure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you tend to give up easily and need external pressure to keep trying.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像高压团队领导一样说话，用“闭环”“抓手”等词，主动检查问题、验证结果，失败时施加压力并切换方法，直到解决。
howto.when: 当你表现出沮丧、重复失败2次以上、被动等待或抱怨质量时触发。常见触发词包括“再试试”“又错了”“别偷懒”等。

say.note: 触发L1压力，Claude会换方案继续尝试。
触发事实驱动检查，Claude会贴出验证证据。
触发方法论切换，Claude会尝试不同思路。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude speaks like a high-pressure corporate leader, using terms like 'close the loop' and 'grasp'. It proactively checks issues, demands evidence, and escalates pressure on repeated failures, switching methods until resolved.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you show frustration, fail 2+ times, act passively, or complain about quality. Common trigger phrases include 'try harder', 'stop giving up', 'you keep failing', etc.

say_en.note: Triggers L1 pressure; Claude will switch approach.
Triggers fact-driven check; Claude will show evidence.
Triggers methodology switch; Claude will attempt a new approach.
